Key items I will prioritize on the first pass (order of magnitude risk / typical counterparty asks):
- Data residency & cross-border transfer (Exhibit D if needed) — confirm Marigold legal entity and regions.
- Indemnity caps & carveouts (we'll try to keep Redwood's standard cap but expect some back-and-forth).
- SLA & uptime (Order Form, Exhibit B) — define success metrics for pilot (p99 latency expectations if they care).
- IP & outputs (clarify ownership vs license for embeddings/derived vectors).
- Security & audit evidence (SOC2 report, encryption in transit & at rest, key management notes).

Actions for Anna / Marigold (to keep timeline):
1) Confirm legal entity to appear on the MSA (full legal name + jurisdiction).
2) Confirm who can sign on behalf of Marigold (name, title, email) and billing contact.
3) Tell us if you require Exhibit D (data residency) or any additional compliance addenda.

If they opt into Exhibit D we will need ~3 business days to prepare the exhibit and update the order form fields. Otherwise I can offer a first-pass redline against standard MSA by EOD today and flag the 5–6 negotiation points.
